opus.problem: The best-known camel story is missing: Jesus saying it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God (Matthew 19:24). Rebekah watering Abraham's servant's camels at the well (Genesis 24) is also left out, while minor details are used instead. Swap the obscure clue 1 (Jeremiah's she-camel) for the eye of the needle clue.
